name: runtime-asset-tracker
description: Track Docker and host assets with broad lifecycle discovery, full-history authority, explicit execution blockers, and exact confirmed cleanup.

interface.shortDescription: Label and trace Docker assets across projects.
interface.longDescription: A cross-project runtime asset console with broad machine-evidence retirement discovery, explicit suspected/blocked/executable candidate states, full-history scoped ledger authority, authenticated loopback HTTP, build provenance, disk-pressure visibility, exact confirmed cleanup, and project-bound Local, EC2, and GitHub inventory. Labels remain useful hints but are not required for discovery. It never stores private keys or cloud secrets and does not introduce release approval gates.
capabilities: Image reference and volume mount analysis
Project-bound EC2 identity and disk capacity
SSH and AWS credential profile references
Current and rollback image protection bindings
Real-byte Git worktree and residual inventory
Unified local, Production, and Staging asset table
Suspected, blocked, and executable retirement states
Actor, instance, digest, and single-use cleanup binding
Capacity-pressure candidate visibility without safety bypass
defaultPrompt: Open the runtime asset dashboard and show what is reclaimable.
Preview safe Docker cleanup without deleting anything.
Show recent runtime asset events across projects.
